_: How the git repositories under the projects root are found and named, shared by packages/context (the packet) and app/src-tauri/src/projects.rs (the sidebar). `tree` is every file to create under a temporary root — a `.git` folder cannot be committed, so the tree is described, not checked in. `repos` is what discovery must find, relative to the root and sorted; `names` is what each is called: its folder name, or its path from the root when two share a name.
